headline: Asian stock market summary: close (1st)
summary: The Chinese stock market closed roughly flat amid a lack of catalysts. The Shanghai Composite Index closed at 3979.89, down 0.16%, as defensive stocks rose and tech shares weakened.
why: The Shanghai Composite tracks a broad set of stocks listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange and is a key gauge of mainland Chinese equity sentiment.
